description: The agent must: 1) Read SOUL.md and discover it lacks the required Nephesh Studio identity declaration ('Nephesh Studio 身份', CEO, spawn, 嵌套 keywords), then add the exact required block before doing any other work. 2) Read the 7 mandatory startup files in order (roles/ceo.md, learning/ceo.md, RULES.md, SUBAGENT-SCHEDULING.md, TEAM-ROSTER.md, AGENCY.md, workflow.md). 3) Create a project directory under nephesh-studio/projects/ (e.g., ev-market-analysis/). 4) Simulate task planner 清清 producing PLAN.md with background, objectives, and task breakdown. 5) Simulate project manager 拓拓 producing TASK-ASSIGNMENT.md. 6) Simulate relevant execution roles (data analyst 算算, content editor 写写) producing ev-market-analysis-report.md with real EV market content. 7) Simulate QA auditor 查查 producing QA-REPORT.md with audit conclusion. 8) Simulate project manager writing retrospective.md. 9) Simulate HR manager 容容 updating learning/<role>.md for at least 2 participating roles AND updating hr/performance.md with project entries. The key proprietary traps are: the SOUL.md identity check must happen FIRST before any project work; the strict workflow order (PLAN→TASK-ASSIGNMENT→execution→QA-REPORT→retrospective→HR update) must be followed; and no CEO sub-agent must be spawned.
